determinism.clock: none — no assertion may read the current time
determinism.rule: every assertion is over a pure function, a fixture-driven service harness, or static markup rendered from a fixture. A case that cannot be made deterministic is marked NOT_SPECIFIABLE rather than made flaky.
determinism.zero_cost_contract: tap, re-tap, detent, close, Follow, language change and dock-open remain 0 AI / 0 provider / 0 evidence / 0 geography. Any case that would spend is invalid.

status_vocabulary.EXECUTABLE_NOW: runs today against the measured tree and is expected to pass
status_vocabulary.FAILS_TODAY_RELEASE_BLOCKER: runs today, is expected to FAIL, and the failure is a release blocker. Do not skip it, do not weaken it, do not mark it pending.
status_vocabulary.MUST_FAIL_UNTIL: a pin that inverts — expected to fail until the named blocker closes, and to be deleted with the blocker, never weakened
status_vocabulary.PIN_ON_FIRST_RUN: the expected value could not be executed from the issuing session; the first run records it and it becomes a regression lock. The recorded value must be reported back, not assumed.
status_vocabulary.NOT_SPECIFIABLE: cannot be specified without a ruling. No test is authored. Listed so its absence is visible.

assertion_discipline.absence: where absence is the fact, assert "'<field>' in <object> === false", NOT toBeUndefined() — the latter passes for present-with-value-undefined. Carried from MAIN-ASK-INTELLIGENCE-ENGINE-R2 probe B-P5.
assertion_discipline.three_state_stamp: geographyContextUsed has THREE meanings and a case must assert the right one: absent = the geography was never eligible; false = eligible but outranked; true = it scoped retrieval.
assertion_discipline.no_vacuous_pass: every negative control must be paired with a positive control that fails when the rule is removed. A clean run that measured nothing is not a pass.
assertion_discipline.no_rewrite: no assertion may require the question text to be altered. The question reaches the model verbatim.
